nusmp.page.book_briar.blue_rose_paradise: Blue Rose Paradise - two concentric magic circles grow briars at the spot you aim at (22 blocks). For 5 s everything within 5 blocks is tangled (3 damage a second, slowed, weakened) and a curse on it is drawn into the blue roses. Charlotte's spell from the years of her curse.
nusmp.page.book_briar.scarlet_braided_sp: Scarlet-Braided Beautiful Battle Spear - red briars braid into a spear that runs 16 blocks through everything on its line for 13 base damage and a poisonous bite. Named in the True Briar list; the effect is inferred from the name.
nusmp.page.book_painting.souterrain_grou: Souterrain Groundswell - painted figures ride a wave of dirt 13 blocks ahead and bury what they hit: 9 base damage, slowed and blinded for a moment, pushed back.
nusmp.page.book_painting.sirenes_game: Sirene's Game - painted mermaids of water crash into what you aim at, 13 blocks ahead: 9 base damage, flames put out, slowed, pushed back.
nusmp.page.book_painting.four_headed_lin: Four-Headed Lindworm - a four-headed serpent is painted in the air and each head breathes an element in a 14 block fan: 8 base damage to up to 8 foes, and one of burning, chill, a lift or weakness each.
nusmp.page.book_painting.vouivres_shout: Phantom Dragon Vouivre's Shout - a winged serpent-woman is painted under you (you fall slowly for 5 s) and shouts a magical blast where the brush points: 15 base damage in 3.5 blocks, thrown back.
nusmp.page.book_painting.souterrain_gian: Souterrain Giant - the upper body of a giant of dense earth rises where you aim and slams the ground three times in 3 s: 7 base damage in 4.5 blocks each, pushed away.
nusmp.page.book_painting.twilight_of_val: Twilight of Valhalla - a many-storeyed hall and winged shield-maidens are painted around you. After 3 s its secondary effect begins: for 8 s you and your allies within 6 blocks gain Regeneration, Resistance and Absorption. The delay is its weakness.
nusmp.page.book_blood.red_beast: Red Beast - costs 3 health. A giant monster of blood stays attached to you for 8 s and rakes everything within 5 blocks every half second (up to 6 foes, 3 base damage each) and feeds you a little of it.
nusmp.page.book_blood.herd_of_red_beasts: Herd of Red Beasts - costs 4 health. A lot of blood is shaped into several smaller beasts, not attached to you, that run through 7 blocks around the spot you aim at for 5 s: 3.5 base damage a half second, slowed.
nusmp.page.book_lightning.tenjiolia: Tenjiolia - lightning shot at great speed from the held-out palm, 30 blocks, bending toward what you look at: 14 base damage and a slow to everything on the line.
nusmp.page.book_lightning.apocalypra_ast: Apocalypra Astrauza - Ultimate Magic. Costs 4 hearts of life force (it will not cast if you cannot afford them). Interconnected mana arrays gather before the hand for 0.6 s, then a beam of lightning runs 40 blocks: 34 base damage to up to 8 foes, thrown back.
nusmp.page.book_mineral.laevateinn: Laevateinn - a great sword of ore is made and swung over a 7 block cone: 22 base damage to up to 8 foes, weakened and thrown back.
nusmp.page.book_song.heal_lullaby: Heal Lullaby - a gentle song that closes wounds: you and your allies within 8 blocks heal a quarter of their health (the usual healing decay applies).
nusmp.page.book_song.mother_lullaby: Mother Lullaby - a lullaby sung at one target within 16 blocks puts it to sleep for about 4 s (held still, blind, weak). A hard control: it shares the 12 s control lock.
